title: Police Arrest Man for Ramming Tesla Cybertruck With Mini Four-Wheeler (Video) | The Gateway Pundit | by Kristinn Taylor
text: A morbidly obese 33-year-old man was arrested by Texarkana, Texas police on Tuesday for ramming a Tesla Cybertruck with a mini four-wheeler. The attack was captured by the Cybertruck’s Sentry Mode video security system. Police say the man may be responsible for other attacks on Teslas in the area that day. Viral video from the Cybertruck shows the attacker almost getting thrown off as he rammed the Tesla, then recovering and switching to reverse. — Eddie Leyva (@ShowLowVlogs) March 26, 2025 Statement and photo by Texarkana, Texas police : We arrested 33 year old Demarqeyun Cox this afternoon after he allegedly damaged multiple Tesla vehicles in separate incidents across the city today. The first report came from the Golden Palace restaurant on Summerhill Road, where surveillance footage from the car itself captured a guy on a mini four-wheeler intentionally ramming a parked Tesla at full speed. While officers were searching for the suspect, another call came in reporting damage to a Tesla in the Lowe’s parking lot. Shortly after that, Officer Blake Lummus spotted Cox riding a mini four-wheeler near Summerhill and New Boston Roads and recognized him as the suspect in the earlier video. After being stopped, Cox initially gave a false name but was quickly identified and taken into custody. After Cox’s arrest, we got yet another report of Tesla damage – this time at Genesis Prime Care on College Drive. So far, Cox has only been charged with one count of felony Criminal Mischief and Failure to Identify. However, officers are working now to figure out if Cox is responsible for the two later incidents. If they determine he is, additional charges may be filed. He is currently being held in the Bi-State Jail as the investigation continues. Photos of Cox on the run: — Dollar Store Thor (@onebigorangecom) March 26, 2025
